results.question: What does the Gold plan include?

retrieved.title: Gold Plan
retrieved.content: The Gold plan offers sum insured options of ₹5 lakh and ₹10 lakh. Premium starts at ₹9,800 per year for an individual aged 18-35. results.question: What is the waiting period for pre-existing diseases like diabetes?

retrieved.title: Pre-existing disease (PED)
retrieved.content: Pre-existing disease must be declared on the proposal form. Declared PED such as diabetes, hypertension, thyroid disorders and asthma is accepted and covered after a waiting period of 36 months. Non-disclosure of a PED can lead to claim rejection or policy cancellation.

results.answer: The waiting period for pre‑existing conditions such as diabetes is 36 months.

retrieved.content: Annual premiums have a grace period of 30 days; monthly instalments have a grace period of 15 days. Claims are not payable for hospitalisation that starts during the unpaid grace period.

results.question: Can I add my 72 year old father to the policy?

retrieved.title: Family members
retrieved.content: A family floater can cover the proposer, spouse, up to 3 dependent children aged 91 days to 25 years, and parents. Parents can be added only under Gold or Platinum, with a maximum entry age of 75 years. Members who are 61 years or older at entry have a 20% co-payment on every claim.

results.answer: Yes, you can add your 72‑year‑old father, but only if you choose a Gold or Platinum family floater and he’s under the 75‑year entry limit.
